title: O’More for Me, Then
author: Isaac Banner
problems: Row 3 "partners allemande right ¾ to long waves, larks facing out" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction (the usual styling).
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
